Scripts.Body:
param([ValidateSet('exploration','confirmation')][string]$Batch = 'exploration')

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')).Path
$runsRoot = Join-Path $root "runs/$Batch"
$pairs = @()
for ($block = 1; $block -le 8; $block++) {
    $baselinePath = Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-baseline/run-summary.json' -f $block)
    $candidatePath = Join-Path $runsRoot ('{0:d2}-candidate/run-summary.json' -f $block)
    if (-not (Test-Path $baselinePath) -or -not (Test-Path $candidatePath)) { throw "Block $block is incomplete." }
    $baseline = Get-Content -Raw $baselinePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    $candidate = Get-Content -Raw $candidatePath | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($baseline.Batch -ne $Batch -or $candidate.Batch -ne $Batch -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne $candidate.InputSHA256 -or $baseline.InputSHA256 -ne 'DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D') { throw "Batch/input mismatch in block $block." }
    $ratio = [double]$candidate.MeanNs/[double]$baseline.MeanNs
    $pairs += [pscustomobject]@{
        Block=$block
        Order=if ($block % 2 -eq 1) {'baseline-candidate'} else {'candidate-baseline'}
        BaselineMeanNs=[double]$baseline.MeanNs
        CandidateMeanNs=[double]$candidate.MeanNs
        CandidateOverBaseline=$ratio
        LogCandidateOverBaseline=[math]::Log($ratio)
        BaselineAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$baseline.AllocatedBytesPerOperation
        CandidateAllocatedBytesPerOperation=[double]$candidate.AllocatedBytesPerOperation
    }
}

$logRatios = @($pairs | ForEach-Object LogCandidateOverBaseline)
$mean = ($logRatios | Measure-Object -Average).Average
$sumSquares = 0.0
foreach ($value in $logRatios) { $sumSquares += [math]::Pow($value-$mean,2) }
$sd = [math]::Sqrt($sumSquares/($logRatios.Count-1))
$se = $sd/[math]::Sqrt($logRatios.Count)
$critical = 2.364624251
$margin = $critical*$se
$summary = [ordered]@{
    Experiment='2026-10-19-recursive-definition'
    Batch=$Batch
    Rule='Use a separate confirmation batch only if the exploration 95% paired log-t interval upper bound is below 1; candidate adoption requires the same condition in confirmation.'
    PairCount=$pairs.Count
    DegreesOfFreedom=$pairs.Count-1
    TCritical95Df7=$critical
    PairedLogRatioMean=$mean
    PairedLogRatioSampleStandardDeviation=$sd
    PairedLogRatioStandardError=$se
    PairedGeometricMeanRatio=[math]::Exp($mean)
    Confidence95=[ordered]@{Lower=[math]::Exp($mean-$margin);Upper=[math]::Exp($mean+$margin)}
    BaselineMeanMs=(($pairs.BaselineMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6)
    CandidateMeanMs=(($pairs.CandidateMeanNs | Measure-Object -Average).Average/1e6)
    Pairs=$pairs
    InputBytes=4172062
    InputSHA256='DC87DD0FB85CB6F875AC336B70FEFC1E32BB1F284C8F6E011E0CB0256F9A354D'
}
$path = Join-Path $root "$Batch-summary.json"
$summary | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $path -Encoding utf8
Write-Output ('{0}: geometric mean ratio {1:F5}; 95% paired log-t interval [{2:F5}, {3:F5}].' -f $Batch,$summary.PairedGeometricMeanRatio,$summary.Confidence95.Lower,$summary.Confidence95.Upper)

param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)][ValidateSet('baseline', 'candidate')][string]$Variant
)

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$root = $PSScriptRoot
$hostRoot = Join-Path $root "$Variant/host"
$run = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new('dotnet')
$run.WorkingDirectory = $hostRoot
$run.UseShellExecute = $false
$run.CreateNoWindow = $true
$run.RedirectStandardOutput = $true
$run.RedirectStandardError = $true
[void]$run.ArgumentList.Add('StringExecutionRecovery.Measurement.dll')
[void]$run.ArgumentList.Add('--validate')
$process = [Diagnostics.Process]::Start($run)
if (-not $process) { throw "Could not start $Variant validation." }
try {
    $stdoutTask = $process.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync()
    $stderrTask = $process.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync()
    $process.WaitForExit()
    $stdout = $stdoutTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    $stderr = $stderrTask.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
    $stdoutPath = Join-Path $root "$Variant/validation.stdout.log"
    $stderrPath = Join-Path $root "$Variant/validation.stderr.log"
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($stdoutPath, $stdout, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    [IO.File]::WriteAllText($stderrPath, $stderr, [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
    if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "$Variant validation exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
    if ($stderr.Length -ne 0) { throw "$Variant validation wrote to stderr." }
    if ($stdout -notmatch 'full input.*expected JSON tree \(100,001 nodes\)') { throw "$Variant validation did not confirm full consumption and the expected tree." }
    $record = [ordered]@{
        Variant = $Variant
        Command = 'dotnet StringExecutionRecovery.Measurement.dll --validate'
        ProcessId = $process.Id
        ExitCode = $process.ExitCode
        InputBytes = (Get-Item (Join-Path $hostRoot 'Data/test.json')).Length
        InputSHA256 = (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $hostRoot 'Data/test.json') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        LibrarySHA256 = (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $hostRoot 'Marimo.Kotowari.dll') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        ParserSHA256 = (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $hostRoot 'Marimo.Parser.dll') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
        FullInputConsumed = $true
        ExpectedNodeCount = 100001
        SystemTextJsonTreeEquivalent = $true
        Stdout = "$Variant/validation.stdout.log"
        Stderr = "$Variant/validation.stderr.log"
    }
    $record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root "$Variant/validation.json") -Encoding utf8
    Write-Output ($record | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)
} finally {
    $process.Dispose()
}
